q: The capacity of an information source (maximal entropy per symbol over all possible source distributions) connects to ergodic theory via the maximum entropy principle. For a stationary source constrained to a subshift X:
opts: The max entropy rate over all shift-invariant measures on X equals h_top(X) (the topological entropy)
exp: Variational principle: max_{μ shift-invariant on X} h_μ(σ) = h_top(X). The topological entropy is the maximum entropy rate achievable over all stationary sources supported on the subshift X. This is the information-theoretic meaning of topological entropy.
